title: Concept: Cookie set without HttpOnly in javascript — review required
description: In javascript, res.cookie writes a value without httpOnly. The browser then exposes the cookie to document.cookie, so a single script injection anywhere on the origin can read it and replay it. The option is easy to forget because the call works identically without it, and nothing at runtime signals the weaker setting.
applicability: javascript Express-style applications that set cookies directly.
risk: Session theft through any script injection; MEDIUM severity.
